=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
- Requirement: "test-and-mark-stable.yml (validate-scripts) and mark-stable.yml now run the same suites before tagging" and the step is named "Claude asset tests (CLAUDE.md, .claude hooks, scripts, commands)", running "the 18 pytest files from the ci.yml Claude steps plus tests/test_session_start_extract_repo_slug.py".
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml (new step "Claude asset tests ...", ~line 427) and .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml (new step "Claude asset tests ...", ~line 4282).
  Evidence of absence: ci.yml's Claude-asset neighborhood (steps at lines 457-534) actually contains 20 pytest files, not 18. The two omitted files both directly cover the shipped `workflow-templates/.claude/` twin that this PR exists to protect:
  - tests/test_audit_plans_command.py (ci.yml:529, step "/audit-plans command contract tests") defines TEMPLATE_COMMAND = workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md and test_template_parity() asserts it equals the root copy (test_audit_plans_command.py:14, :29-30). A regression or template drift in the shipped /audit-plans command will not fail the release gate.
  - tests/test_ingest_implement_plan_lessons.py (ci.yml:534, step "Implement-plan lessons ingestion + conformance-stage contract tests") sets COMMAND_COPIES = (.claude/commands, workflow-templates/.claude/commands) and test_implement_plan_claude_copies_are_identical() asserts the implement-plan-claude.md twin parity (test_ingest_implement_plan_lessons.py:272-280). A drift in that shipped command will not fail the release gate.
  The new step's pytest invocation in both workflows lists neither file. The PR description's "18 pytest files from the ci.yml Claude steps" and the changelog fragment's "19 (18 pytest files plus ...)" both undercount by two. The whole stated goal — "a regression in those files fails the release instead of shipping" — is only partially met for the two command files that have explicit template-parity tests.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: (PR description Testing section) "The new gate step's exact commands: 1352 passed, 1 skipped (36 s)" — implies the PR author ran the assembled step locally and it passed, but that suite run did not include the two ci.yml Claude tests above, so the local pass count does not validate parity with ci.yml's Claude coverage.
  Expected change site: the pytest invocation list in .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml and .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml "Claude asset tests" step.
  Evidence of absence: the local run that produced "1352 passed" used the 18-file list; adding the two missing files is needed before the claim "the same suites CI runs" is accurate. (This is the same gap as above, surfaced as a verification-claim discrepancy.)
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
